keys.name: quarkus.oidc.auth-server-url
keys.doc: Base URL of the RHBK realm: https://<rhbk>/realms/<realm>; discovery reads the rest

keys.name: quarkus.oidc.client-id
keys.doc: The client of this application in the realm

keys.name: quarkus.oidc.credentials.secret
keys.doc: Client secret, from the vault; needed by confidential clients (token introspection, code flow), not by a bearer-only API

keys.name: quarkus.oidc.token.audience
keys.doc: Expected aud claim; set when the realm issues tokens for several APIs

keys.name: quarkus.oidc.application-type
keys.doc: service (bearer tokens) or web-app (authorization code flow with cookies)
